content: Check-in is from 3:00 pm to 10:00 pm. Check-out is before 11:00 am. Early check-in is possible only if the room is ready, and costs nothing extra.
Water Monkey Guesthouse, No. 8, Lakeside Lane. It is a 10-minute walk from the bus station. The guesthouse is next to the river, behind the old temple.
There are 6 free car parking spaces and free scooter parking. Parking is first come, first served and cannot be booked.
Breakfast is included in every room. It is served from 7:30 am to 9:30 am in the dining room on the first floor. Guests can choose a Taiwanese or Western breakfast.
We accept cash, credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB) and LINE Pay. A 30% deposit is needed to confirm a booking. The rest is paid at check-in.

Cancel 7 or more days before check-in: full refund of the deposit. Cancel 3 to 6 days before: 50% of the deposit is refunded. Cancel 2 days or less before: no refund. Bookings can be moved to a new date once for free if there is a typhoon warning.
Stays of 3 nights or more get 10% off the room price. An extra bed costs NT$500 per night and is available only in Family and Family Suite rooms.
Small pets under 10 kg are welcome only in rooms marked pet_friendly = yes. There is a pet cleaning fee of NT$300 per stay.
Free Wi-Fi in every room and in the dining room. The Wi-Fi name and password are on the card in your room.
All rooms and indoor areas are non-smoking. Guests may smoke only in the garden. Smoking indoors has a cleaning fee of NT$3,000.
The owner, Ms. Lin, can be reached at 0912-345-678 (phone or LINE) from 8:00 am to 10:00 pm. Use this number for complaints, special requests and anything the agent cannot answer.
